run_summarize_cli: run the BART summarization CLI with --model-dir, --src, and --out arguments to summarize text
generate_summaries: generate summaries from a source text file using a pretrained BART model with batched inference
load_bart_model: load a pretrained BART model from a local directory or via torch.hub for summarization
summarize_with_xsum_kwargs: summarize text using XSUM_KWARGS with beam 6, max length 60, and no repeat ngram size 3
summarize_with_cnn_kwargs: summarize text using CNN_KWARGS with beam 4, length penalty 2.0, and max length 140
